concepts.topic_fa: مرجع/مشتق، OLTP/OLAP، ETL/reverse ETL
concepts.topic_en: Record/derived, OLTP/OLAP, ETL/reverse ETL
concepts.decision_fa: run و policy مرجع؛ retrieval و dashboard مشتق؛ تحلیل offline از manifest پایدار.
concepts.decision_en: Runs/policies are records; retrieval/dashboards are derived; offline analytics use stable manifests.

concepts.topic_fa: build/buy، کلاود، توزیع، microservice/serverless
concepts.topic_en: Build/buy, cloud, distribution, microservices/serverless
concepts.decision_fa: adapter و engine موجود؛ worker جدا برای کار طولانی؛ استقرار اولیه محدود و تصمیمِ توزیع مستند.
concepts.decision_en: Use existing adapters/engines; separate long-running workers; document initial deployment/distribution decisions.

evidence_fa: یک ADR با دو گزینه و هزینه/latency/پیچیدگی بنویس.
evidence_en: Write an ADR comparing two options on cost, latency, and complexity.

concepts.topic_fa: response time، throughput، percentile، tail latency
concepts.topic_en: Response time, throughput, percentiles, tail latency
concepts.decision_fa: admission و completion جدا؛ صف، p95 و retry storm در load test.
concepts.decision_en: Separate admission/completion; load-test queues, p95, and retry storms.

concepts.topic_fa: SLO/SLA، reliability، overload، maintainability
concepts.topic_en: SLO/SLA, reliability, overload, maintainability
concepts.decision_fa: SLO آموزشی، error budget، backpressure، ران‌بوک و deployment تکرارپذیر.
concepts.decision_en: Experimental SLOs, error budgets, backpressure, runbooks, repeatable deployments.

evidence_fa: burst را تزریق و نمودار queue/latency/error تهیه کن.
evidence_en: Inject bursts and plot queue, latency, and errors.

concepts.topic_fa: relational/document، normalization، ORM، schema-on-read/write
concepts.topic_en: Relational/document, normalization, ORM, read/write schemas
concepts.decision_fa: رابطهٔ tenant/run نرمال؛ payload سند versioned؛ JSON مرزِ constraint را حذف نمی‌کند.
concepts.decision_en: Normalize tenant/run relations; version document payloads; JSON does not replace constraints.

concepts.topic_fa: graph، declarative query، star/snowflake/OBT، CQRS/event sourcing
concepts.topic_en: Graphs, declarative queries, star/snowflake/OBT, CQRS/event sourcing
concepts.decision_fa: dependency سرویس با graph منطقی؛ SQL محدود؛ OLAP fact/dimension؛ session log با state مشتق.
concepts.decision_en: Logical service graph, bounded SQL, analytical facts/dimensions, session log with derived state.

evidence_fa: FK cross-tenant را رد و projection از event را بازسازی کن.
evidence_en: Reject cross-tenant FKs and rebuild an event projection.

concepts.topic_fa: WAL، B-tree، LSM، SSTable، Bloom، compaction
concepts.topic_en: WAL, B-trees, LSM, SSTables, Bloom, compaction
concepts.decision_fa: WAL برای recovery؛ index claim؛ گزینهٔ LSM در log store؛ false positive Bloom صحت را تغییر ندهد.
concepts.decision_en: WAL recovery, claim indexes, LSM alternatives for logs; Bloom false positives must not change correctness.

concepts.topic_fa: secondary/local/global index، columnar، compression، materialization، text/vector
concepts.topic_en: Secondary/local/global indexes, columnar, compression, materialization, text/vector
concepts.decision_fa: lookup tenant-local؛ telemetry زمان‌محور؛ eval ستونی؛ retrieval lexical/dense با benchmark.
concepts.decision_en: Tenant-local lookup, time-based telemetry, columnar evaluation, benchmarked lexical/dense retrieval.

evidence_fa: explain query و مقایسهٔ recall/latency سه روش retrieval را ثبت کن.
evidence_en: Record query plans and recall/latency for three retrieval baselines.

concepts.topic_fa: JSON/Protobuf/Avro، default، unknown field، backward/forward
concepts.topic_en: JSON/Protobuf/Avro, defaults, unknown fields, backward/forward
concepts.decision_fa: envelope نسخه‌دار؛ rollout producer/consumer؛ golden fixture قدیمی و جدید.
concepts.decision_en: Versioned envelope, producer/consumer rollouts, old/new golden fixtures.

concepts.topic_fa: DB/RPC/event dataflow، durable execution، schema lifecycle
concepts.topic_en: DB/RPC/event dataflow, durable execution, schema lifecycle
concepts.decision_fa: HTTP sync برای query، event async برای تغییر؛ expand/migrate/contract و mapper manifest.
concepts.decision_en: Sync HTTP queries, async change events, expand/migrate/contract, mapper manifests.

evidence_fa: consumer قبلی را با event تازه و replay قدیمی تست کن.
evidence_en: Test old consumers with new events and old replay.

concepts.topic_fa: single/multi/leaderless، sync/async، snapshot، failover، log methods
concepts.topic_en: Single/multi/leaderless, sync/async, snapshots, failover, log methods
concepts.decision_fa: primary واحد برای budget/claim؛ logical CDC؛ snapshot هماهنگ؛ HA مشروط به writer fencing.
concepts.decision_en: One primary for budgets/claims, logical CDC, coordinated snapshots, HA with writer fencing.

concepts.topic_fa: read-your-writes، monotonic/prefix، quorum، conflict/version vector، tombstone
concepts.topic_en: Read-your-writes, monotonic/prefix, quorum, conflicts/version vectors, tombstones
concepts.decision_fa: token پیشرفت برای خواندن؛ primary برای guard؛ multi-leader در budget انتخاب نمی‌شود؛ افق حذف صریح.
concepts.decision_en: Progress tokens, primary guard reads, no multi-leader budget writes, explicit deletion horizon.

evidence_fa: replica lag و failover را تزریق و read-after-write را بررسی کن.
evidence_en: Inject replica lag/failover and check read-after-write.

concepts.topic_fa: range/hash، consistent hashing، mod N، virtual bucket، hotspot
concepts.topic_en: Range/hash, consistent hashing, mod N, virtual buckets, hotspots
concepts.decision_fa: telemetry با زمان+tenant؛ run با hash؛ tenant بزرگ virtual bucket؛ quota از hotspot دفاع می‌کند.
concepts.decision_en: Time/tenant telemetry, hashed runs, large-tenant virtual buckets, hotspot quotas.

concepts.topic_fa: routing، rebalancing، shard lifecycle، secondary local/global
concepts.topic_en: Routing, rebalancing, shard lifecycle, local/global secondary indexes
concepts.decision_fa: mapping versioned و epoch؛ migration topic با drain؛ retrieval cross-shard fan-out هزینه دارد.
concepts.decision_en: Versioned mapping/epochs, drained topic migrations, explicit cross-shard retrieval cost.

evidence_fa: tenant پرمصرف و تغییر partition mapping را بدون شکست ترتیب اجرا کن.
evidence_en: Exercise a noisy tenant and partition remapping without broken ordering.

concepts.topic_fa: ACID/MVCC، read committed/SI، lost update/write skew/phantom
concepts.topic_en: ACID/MVCC, read committed/SI, lost update/write skew/phantoms
concepts.decision_fa: budget reservation و claim با شرط اتمی؛ snapshot isolation به‌تنهایی سقف مجموع را حفظ نمی‌کند.
concepts.decision_en: Atomic budget reservations/claims; snapshot isolation alone does not protect aggregate caps.

concepts.topic_fa: serial execution/2PL/SSI، retry، 2PC، idempotency
concepts.topic_en: Serial execution/2PL/SSI, retries, 2PC, idempotency
concepts.decision_fa: constraint و قفل یا serializable با retry؛ SQL inbox+effect اتمی؛ sink بیرونی قرارداد جدا.
concepts.decision_en: Constraints/locks or serializable retries; atomic SQL inbox/effects; separate external-sink contracts.

evidence_fa: دو درخواست هم‌زمان بودجه و crash بین effect/offset را تست کن.
evidence_en: Test concurrent budget requests and effect/offset crashes.

concepts.topic_fa: partial failure، timeout/TCP/queue، clocks/skew/pause
concepts.topic_en: Partial failures, timeouts/TCP/queues, clocks/skew/pauses
concepts.decision_fa: deadline و outcome نامعلوم؛ event/observed/ingested جدا؛ pause worker و GC در تست.
concepts.decision_en: Deadlines/unknown outcomes, distinct timestamps, worker/GC pauses in tests.

concepts.topic_fa: lease/fencing، majority، Byzantine، safety/liveness/system model
concepts.topic_en: Leases/fencing, majority, Byzantine faults, safety/liveness/system models
concepts.decision_fa: epoch در sink enforce؛ model output ورودی نامطمئن؛ crash-fault baseline و توقف امن در partition.
concepts.decision_en: Sink-enforced epochs, untrusted model outputs, crash-fault baseline, safe partition behavior.

evidence_fa: worker زامبی و پاسخ دیررس را بساز و stale commit را رد کن.
evidence_en: Create zombie workers/late replies and reject stale commits.

concepts.topic_fa: linearizability/serializability، CAP/PACELC، ID/Lamport/HLC
concepts.topic_en: Linearizability/serializability, CAP/PACELC, IDs/Lamport/HLC
concepts.decision_fa: promotion و ownership نیازمند CAS معتبر؛ UUID ترتیب global نمی‌سازد؛ ساعت منطقی causal label است.
concepts.decision_en: Promotion/ownership need authoritative CAS; UUIDs do not create global order; logical clocks label causality.

concepts.topic_fa: consensus log/epoch/quorum، coordination/discovery
concepts.topic_en: Consensus logs/epochs/quorums, coordination/discovery
concepts.decision_fa: به هماهنگی ابزار HA اتکا می‌کنیم؛ الگوریتم consensus تازه نمی‌نویسیم؛ minority حق dispatch حساس ندارد.
concepts.decision_en: Use existing HA coordination; do not write a new consensus algorithm; minority cannot authorize sensitive dispatch.

evidence_fa: تاریخچهٔ claim/promotion را با oracle محدود خطی‌سنجی کن.
evidence_en: Check claim/promotion histories against a bounded linearizability oracle.

concepts.topic_fa: bounded/unbounded، UNIX pipeline، external sort، object store، DAG
concepts.topic_en: Bounded/unbounded inputs, UNIX pipelines, external sort, object storage, DAGs
concepts.decision_fa: rebuild از manifest immutable؛ pipeline extraction/chunk/embed/eval؛ spill برای data بزرگ.
concepts.decision_en: Rebuild immutable manifests; extraction/chunk/embed/eval pipelines; spill large inputs.

concepts.topic_fa: MapReduce/dataflow، shuffle/join، skew/straggler، attempts، atomic publish
concepts.topic_en: MapReduce/dataflow, shuffle/joins, skew/stragglers, attempts, atomic publication
concepts.decision_fa: attempt output جدا؛ manifest فقط برنده؛ همهٔ chunkها پیش از pointer نسل؛ backfill/analytics.
concepts.decision_en: Separate attempt outputs, winner manifests, complete chunks before pointer publication, backfill/analytics.

evidence_fa: mapper/embedding attempt را kill و خروجی ناقص را نامرئی نگه دار.
evidence_en: Kill attempts and keep incomplete outputs invisible.

concepts.topic_fa: broker/log، offset، partition، backpressure، DLQ، retention
concepts.topic_en: Brokers/logs, offsets, partitions, backpressure, DLQ, retention
concepts.decision_fa: entity ordering؛ poison event degraded؛ WAL+Kafka horizon؛ مصرف‌کنندهٔ مستقل.
concepts.decision_en: Entity ordering, degraded poison events, WAL/Kafka horizons, independent consumers.

concepts.topic_fa: dual write/outbox، snapshot/compaction، state-stream، joins/windows/watermark، exactly-once
concepts.topic_en: Dual writes/outbox, snapshot/compaction, state-stream, joins/windows/watermarks, exactly-once
concepts.decision_fa: seed+delta؛ deletion guard؛ window correction؛ effectively-once تنها داخل مرزِ اثبات‌شده.
concepts.decision_en: Seed/deltas, deletion guards, window corrections, effectively-once only within proven boundaries.

evidence_fa: overlap، reorder، delete و outage خارج از retention را آزمایش کن.
evidence_en: Test overlap, reordering, deletes, and outages beyond retention.

concepts.topic_fa: derived/unbundled، dataflow/RPC، causality، migration، lambda/kappa
concepts.topic_en: Derived/unbundled systems, dataflow/RPC, causality, migration, lambda/kappa
concepts.decision_fa: context از log مشتق؛ query sync؛ shadow generation و reprocessing با یک mapper نسخه‌دار.
concepts.decision_en: Log-derived context, sync queries, shadow generations, versioned reprocessing mapper.

concepts.topic_fa: timeliness/integrity، constraint/coordination، async apology، audit/checker
concepts.topic_en: Timeliness/integrity, constraints/coordination, async apologies, audits/checkers
concepts.decision_fa: freshness جدا از صحت؛ budget sync guard؛ reconciliation بیرونی؛ checksum در cut مشترک.
concepts.decision_en: Freshness differs from integrity; synchronous budget guards, external reconciliation, same-cut checksums.

evidence_fa: checker مرجع/مشتق را در cut یکسان اجرا و اصلاح drift را ثبت کن.
evidence_en: Run same-cut record/projection checks and record drift repair.

concepts.topic_fa: bias/proxy/feedback loop، explainability، algorithmic exclusion
concepts.topic_en: Bias/proxies/feedback loops, explainability, algorithmic exclusion
concepts.decision_fa: گزارش agent امتیاز کارکنان نیست؛ عدم‌قطعیت و حق اعتراض؛ eval per-family برای کورشدن نسبت به رخدادهای کم‌تکرار.
concepts.decision_en: No automatic employee scores; uncertainty/challenge; per-family evals for rare failures.

concepts.topic_fa: surveillance/consent/power، minimization، retention، erasure
concepts.topic_en: Surveillance/consent/power, minimization, retention, erasure
concepts.decision_fa: synthetic lab؛ purpose limitation؛ redact trace؛ حذف متن/vector/cache/backup و restore guard.
concepts.decision_en: Synthetic lab, purpose limits, redacted traces, text/vector/cache/backup deletion and restore guards.

evidence_fa: دادهٔ حذف‌شده و دسترسی لغوشده را در replay/restore و citation امتحان کن.
evidence_en: Test erased/revoked data in replay, restore, and citations.
